title: Bamboo Cathedral to Bagatelle with Island Hikers
summary: A challenging 5–6 hour guided loop from Macqueripe through the Bamboo Cathedral to Bagatelle for TT$80.
description: Island Hikers lists a challenging 5–6 hour Bamboo Cathedral to Bagatelle loop for Saturday 3 October 2026. Meet at Macqueripe Car Park at 7:30 AM. The advertised fee is TT$80 and payment can be made on the day of the hike.
